lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸੇ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: pekh darasan naanak bigase aap lae milaae ||4||5||8||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, Nanak has blossomed forth; the Lord has united him in Union. ||4||5||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨਗਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: abichal nagar gobi(n)d guroo kaa naam japat sukh paaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Eternal and immovable is the City of God and Guru; chanting His Name, I have found peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ichhe seee phal paae karatai aap vasaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires; the Creator Himself established it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਸਿਖ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karatai aap vasaaiaa sarab sukh paaiaa put bhaaee sikh bigaase ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself established it. I have found total peace; my children, siblings and Sikhs have all blossomed forth in bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahi pooran paramesur kaaraj aaiaa raase ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, my affairs have come to be resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh aap suaamee aape rakhaa aap pitaa aap maaiaa ||
lines.translation: God Himself is my Lord and Master. He Himself is my Saving Grace; He Himself is my father and mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak satigur balihaaree jin ehu thaan suhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has embellished and adorned this place. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ਸੋਹੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ma(n)dar hatanaale sohe jis vich naam nivaasee raam ||
lines.translation: Homes, mansions, stores and markets are beautiful, when the Lord's Name abides within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t bhagat har naam araadhahi kateeai jam kee phaasee raam ||
lines.translation: The Saints and devotees worship the Lord's Name in adoration, and the noose of Death is cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaatee jam phaasee prabh abinaasee har har naam dhiaae ||
lines.translation: The noose of Death is cut away, meditating on the Name of the Eternal, Unchanging Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree pooran hoee man ichhe phal paae ||
lines.translation: Everything is perfect for them, and they obtain the fruits of their mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sajan sukh maanahi raleeaa dookh darad bhram naasee ||
lines.translation: The Saints and friends enjoy peace and pleasure; their pain, suffering and doubts are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabad savaare satigur poorai naanak sad bal jaasee ||2||
lines.translation: The Perfect True Guru has embellished them with the Word of the Shabad; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: daat khasam kee pooree hoee nit nit chaRai savaaee raam ||
lines.translation: The gift of our Lord and Master is perfect; it increases day by day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham khasamaanaa keeaa jis dee vadee vadiaaee raam ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God has made me His own; His Glorious Greatness is so great!

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad bhagatan kaa raakhaa so prabh bhaiaa daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Protector of His devotees; God has become merciful to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh sukhee vasaae prabh aape kar pratipaalaa ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures now dwell in peace; God Himself cherishes and cares for them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dah dis poor rahiaa jas suaamee keemat kahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The Praises of the Lord and Master are totally pervading in the ten directions; I cannot express His worth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak satigur balihaaree jin abichal neev rakhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has laid this eternal foundation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan pooran paramesur har har kathaa nit suneeai raam ||
lines.translation: The spiritual wisdom and meditation of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, are continually heard there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਚੋਜ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad choj bhagat bhav bha(n)jan anahad vaaje dhuneeai raam ||
lines.translation: The devotees of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, play endlessly there, and the unstruck melody resounds and vibrates there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad jhunakaare tat beechaare sa(n)t gosat nit hovai ||
lines.translation: The unstruck melody resounds and resonates, and the Saints contemplate the essence of reality; this discourse is their daily routine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam araadhahi mail sabh kaatahi kilavikh sagale khovai ||
lines.translation: They worship the Lord's Name, and all their filth is washed away; they rid themselves of all sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋੁਨੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: tah janam na maranaa aavan jaanaa bahuR na paaeeai jouneeai ||
lines.translation: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going, and no entering into the womb of reincarnation again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀਐ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur paramesar paaiaa jis prasaad ichh puneeai ||4||6||9||
lines.translation: Nanak has found the Guru, the Transcendent Lord; by His Grace, desires are fulfilled. ||4||6||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa ke kaaraj aap khaloiaa har ka(n)m karaavan aaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself has stood up to resolve the affairs of the Saints; He has come to complete their tasks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਤਾਲੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharat suhaavee taal suhaavaa vich a(n)mrit jal chhaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: The land is beautiful, and the pool is beautiful; within it is contained the Ambrosial Water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit jal chhaaiaa pooran saaj karaaiaa sagal manorath poore ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Water is filling it, and my job is perfectly complete; all my desires are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar bhaiaa jag a(n)tar laathe sagal visoore ||
lines.translation: Congratulations are pouring in from all over the world; all my sorrows are eliminated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜਸੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran purakh achut abinaasee jas ved puraanee gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing the Praises of the Perfect, Unchanging, Imperishable Primal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa birad rakhiaa paramesar naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Transcendent Lord has kept His promise, and confirmed His nature; Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: nav nidh sidh ridh deene karate tot na aavai kaaee raam ||
lines.translation: The Creator has given me the nine treasures, wealth and spiritual powers, and I do not lack anything.
